changelog: Sync from structs-ai v1.25.0: updated content, commands, and mechanics for v0.21.0
summary: Building interfaces and clients in the Structs universe — dashboards, forms, menus, HUDs, and companion apps using SUI, the design system the game itself is built with. Use when asked to build, style, or extend any Structs UI, or when writing client code that signs transactions, computes proof-of-work, or consumes GRASS events. This is about building software, not playing the game.
